messages:
Carlos Mendes: quick catch from QA — the /v1/generate API docs still show `timeout` as a string and example responses use `generation` (singular). live service expects `timeout_ms` (integer) and returns `generations` array. QA hit a 400 when using the old examples.

Yvonne Liu: thanks Carlos. which repo/file? can you paste the failing curl?

Carlos Mendes: openapi/specs/generate.yaml and docs/examples/generate.md. repro: `curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?timeout=5000\" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hey"}'` -> 400 invalid type for timeout. server accepts `timeout_ms=5000` or header `X-Timeout-Ms: 5000`.

Grace Kim: confirmed on staging. We renamed to `timeout_ms` to be explicit and removed string coercion. Looks like docs lagged. I'll open a PR to update OpenAPI param to integer, update curl/python/js/go examples to use `timeout_ms` (HTTP) and note SDK mappings (`timeoutMs` in JS, `timeout_ms` kwarg in Python, `TimeoutMs` field in Go struct).

Nora Patel: small UX question — do we want to keep a short compatibility note in the API ref that older clients passing `timeout` as a string will see 400s now? or should we add a compatibility shim server-side for one release?

Yvonne Liu: ops prefers no shim; we made the change intentionally. Docs + migration note + changelog should be sufficient. Add an explicit migration page in docs/migrations named `2026-03-timeout-ms-and-generations.md` with exact YAML/JSON diffs.

Grace Kim: PR plan: (1) edit openapi/specs/generate.yaml to replace `timeout` param with `timeout_ms` integer, (2) update examples in docs/examples/generate.md and SDK snippets in docs/sdks/, (3) add migration doc under docs/migrations/, (4) add CHANGELOG entry. Will include copy-paste snippets below for reviewers.

Carlos Mendes: please include both query param and header examples. snippet for OpenAPI param to use:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: timeout_ms
    in: query
    schema:
      type: integer
      format: int32
      example: 5000
    description: Timeout in milliseconds. Alternative: set header `X-Timeout-Ms`.
```

Grace Kim: updated response example to prefer `generations` array and add perf section. JSON sample for docs:
```json
{
  "id": "req_9d2f",
  "model": "rwd-13b",
  "generations": [
    {"text": "ok", "tokens": ["ok"], "metadata": {}}
  ],
  "perf": {"latency_ms": 28}
}
```

Nora Patel: add a one-liner mapping note for SDKs: HTTP `timeout_ms` -> JS `timeoutMs`, Python `timeout_ms` kwarg, Go `TimeoutMs` field. Also mention that server accepts `X-Timeout-Ms` header.

infra-bot: please remember to add an integration smoke test asserting `generations` key present in responses to catch regressions.

Yvonne Liu: assigning reviewers @Carlos Mendes @Nora Patel. PR will be labeled docs, breaking-change, needs-review. No shim — we'll coordinate a customer-facing note. Also tag support to prepare canned responses for any confused customers.

Grace Kim: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/5033 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review). Will merge after 2 approvals and green CI.

Carlos Mendes: thanks — i'll run a staging smoke after merge and post results. :thumbsup:
